text:
Maya: Quick check — planning to flip the rollout toggle for model v9 tomorrow morning. Thinking percent-based drip + region holdback for APAC first. Any objections?
Ajay: Fine with that. Can we keep a 1% initial slice for 30m then double every 30m if metrics look good?
Sam: +1. Metrics to watch: tail latency p99, token cost per request, and failed decode rate. Put thresholds in the flag so it auto-stops on regression.
Maya: Good call. Suggested thresholds: p99 > 350ms OR error-rate delta > 0.5% OR avg tokens up 15% — auto-pause. Thoughts?
Lina: Sounds reasonable. Add a quality gate too: eval set similarity drop > 2% (we have the smoke eval in /dashboards/model-v9-smoke).
Maya: Will add. Draft flag payload I plan to push:```json
{
  "feature": "model_v9_canary",
  "stages": [
    {"percent": 1, "duration_min": 30},
    {"percent": 2, "duration_min": 30},
    {"percent": 5, "duration_min": 60},
    {"percent": 15, "duration_min": 60}
  ],
  "region_holdout": ["apac"],
  "auto_pause_on": {
    "p99_ms": 350,
    "error_rate_delta_pct": 0.5,
    "tokens_delta_pct": 15,
    "eval_similarity_drop_pct": 2
  }
}
```Maya: Pushing for a 09:00 UTC start to catch NA morning and EU afternoon.
Ryan-oncall: I'll monitor during the ramp. If auto-pause triggers, please ping #eng-oncall and I'll triage.
Sam: Add an opt-in internal audience flag `internal_beta` for 100% internal traffic first (support/dev accounts) — sanity check before public drip.
Maya: Good idea. I'll enable internal_beta for 2 hours before 1% public.
Ajay: For rollback playbook: immediate revert to model_v8 if auto-pause + p99 > 500ms or error-rate > 2%. Otherwise manual review.
Lina: Also ensure the routing fallback to smaller quantized variant is configured: `model_v9_q4fallback` in routing rules.
deploy-bot: Scheduled rollout: model_v9_canary at 2026-03-18T09:00:00Z (operator: Maya). Notifications will be posted to #deploys and #eng-oncall. :rocket:
Maya: Thanks — I'll open a tiny runbook snippet in the thread and add links to dashboards before the start. If no objections by EOD I'll push the flag config to staging. :thumbsup:
